name: Roll for the Galaxy
summary: Dice-driven tableau engine builder where players simultaneously select phases to develop technologies and settle worlds.
rules_text: Each player has dice representing workers and a personal tableau. Each round all roll their dice behind a screen. Simultaneously each assigns dice to phases: Explore, Develop, Settle, Produce, Ship, and selects one phase to activate for everyone. Phases only occur if at least one player selected them. Players then resolve chosen phases simultaneously but workers act sequentially: Explore draws world/technology tiles, Develop/Settle pay dice to add tiles to tableau gaining powers, Produce creates goods on worlds, Ship consumes goods for VPs and money. Unused workers return to cup, used go to citizenry. Powers modify costs and actions. Game ends when a player has 12 tableau tiles or VP pool empties, then most VPs wins.
